hook: Fifteen questions, no second chances. Can you score fifteen out of fifteen? Let us find out.

questions.question: What is the chemical symbol for gold?

questions.question: What is the chemical formula of water?
questions.question_speech: Question two. What is the chemical formula of water? A. H2O2. B. H2O. C. HO2. D. OH.

questions.question: Which is the lightest chemical element?
questions.question_speech: Question three. Which is the lightest chemical element? A. Lithium. B. Oxygen. C. Hydrogen. D. Helium.

questions.question: What is the chemical symbol for sodium?
questions.question_speech: Question four. What is the chemical symbol for sodium? A. Sd. B. Na. C. So. D. S.

questions.question: Which element has the symbol O?
questions.question_speech: Question five. Which element has the symbol O? A. Osmium. B. Gold. C. Oxygen. D. Oganesson.

questions.question: Which noble gas is used to fill party balloons so they float?
questions.question_speech: Question six. Which noble gas is used to fill party balloons so they float? A. Argon. B. Neon. C. Radon. D. Helium.

questions.question: Which gas makes up most of Earth's atmosphere?

questions.question: What is the chemical symbol for iron?
questions.question_speech: Question eleven. What is the chemical symbol for iron? A. Fe. B. In. C. Ir. D. I.

questions.question: Diamond is a form of which element?

questions.question: Who created the first widely recognized periodic table in 1869?

questions.question: Which metal is the best conductor of electricity?
questions.question_speech: Question fourteen. Which metal is the best conductor of electricity? A. Aluminum. B. Gold. C. Silver. D. Iron.

questions.question: Which state of matter has no fixed shape and no fixed volume?
